title: Safari Torchlight (v7)
description: Roguelike safari survival: collect torch parts, light the big torch, choose monsters to unleash, and spend sapphire torches on upgrades like dash, jet pack, shield, wings, or a buggy!
prompt:
do the following changes.

1. make a dash ability for the player. the keyboard input for dash is going to be f and it dashes in the direction the player is moving. the dash has a 10 second cooldown

2. add upgrades for the player so every time the player gets all the torch parts a bunch of sapphire torches spawn on the map. when you collect the sapphire torches it goes to a currency. the currency will allow you to buy upgrades for the player i will give you 5 ideas for upgrades you can only pick from three upgrades from a when upgrades come. first upgrade idea a brighter torch so just make it so the player gets a 1.3* more bigger brightness range call the upgrade brighter torch and the upgrade will cost 3 sapphire torches. second upgrade idea is a jet pack. when the player clicks space bar you fly for three seconds you can go over monsters when the player is flying with the jet pack and not be killed and while flying with the jet pack you go 1.5* faster the jet pack ability will have a 15 second cooldown and will cost 75 sapphire torches. the third upgrade idea will be a shield it will look like a transparent torch that circle's around the player so the shield just allows the player to take a hit from a monster and not die. if a monster hits you with the shield the monster will be stunned for 5 seconds and no other monsters can hit you for 2 seconds. the shield will cost 60 sapphire torches. the fourth upgrade idea will be a pair of fake wings they will make the player 1.15* faster and they will cost 25 sapphire torches. the fiveth upgrade idea is a buggy it will cost 1000 sapphire torches. it will make the player 5* faster and change the player model to a zebra driving a buggy.

3. make the giraffe monster 3* smaller.

4. make it so the frog doesn't kill the player if the player get's sucked into the frog.
